entry.title: Ghirardelli joins Dubai chocolate craze with new-look Squares
entry.summary: Ghirardelli has joined the Dubai chocolate trend, redesigning its iconic Squares with a thicker format to accommodate the viral treat's signature pistachio filling and crispy kataifi. The launch highlights the growing influence of Dubai-style chocolate on confectionery innovation.
